title: From opening the role to day one: a senior engineer hire, week by week
variant: Weeks as columns, two rows for two points of view
prompt: What happens when in our hiring process for a senior engineer, from opening the role to day one.
note: Time runs left to right as weeks in columns, with the company's steps on one row and the candidate's view of the same week under it, because a plan is read by the people inside it and the second row is what a delay costs. Serif headings and wide margins keep it airy, owners are small chips rather than a column, the current week is the one toned column with a brand top rule where past weeks are dark and future weeks light, and the three decisions that set the pace are flagged in their cells and repeated below the grid.
